question.value: Can dust-based models without radial dust evolution reproduce the observed 12CO outer radius and gas-dust size difference in Lupus disks, or is radial drift and grain growth required?

evidence.quote: determine whether radial dust evolution is required to match the observed gas–dust size difference.

method.value: Tapered power-law surface density from Tazzari et al. 2017 with Gaussian vertical structure, settled large grains, stellar spectrum plus accretion UV

evidence.quote: By using this surface density for the gas in our model, the gas and millimetre-sized grains follow the same surface density profile.
we set $f_{\rm large} = 0.99$ and $\chi =0.2$

assumptions.value: No radial dust evolution; gas and mm dust share same surface density

evidence.quote: Our null hypothesis is thus that no radial-dependent dust evolution has occurred.

validation.value: Models compared to observed 890 um radial profiles and sizes; agree within 15% except Sz 98

evidence.quote: The models and observations agree to within 15 % except for Sz 98 ($\sim 29\%$).

method.value: Lower C and O abundances (or gas-to-dust ratio) until 13CO 3-2 flux matches observations; only CO-underabundant models shown

evidence.quote: we run a CO underabundant model for each source, where we lower the C and O abundances until the $^{13}$CO 3 - 2 line flux matches the observations.

validation.value: Gas-depleted and CO-underabundant approaches yield near identical results

evidence.quote: Our tests show that both approaches yield near identical results.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure model outer radii with noise

method.value: Convolve with beam, add observed noise patches, apply Keplerian mask, make moment-zero map, curve of growth for 90% flux in elliptical apertures; ~1000 noise realisations

evidence.quote: This process is repeated for approximately $1000$ noise realisation

key_parameters.value: Keplerian mask parameters M*, PA, i, centroid from literature; Vsys and DeltaV_int tuned to maximize S/N

evidence.quote: were obtained by varying them to maximize the total S/N in the moment-zero map.

validation.value: Tests show full synthetic CLEAN observations give approximately the same radii

evidence.quote: However, tests show that both methods yield approximately the same measured gas and dust outer radii.

findings_qualitative.value: Disks with small gas-dust size differences in the bright sample may be explained by optical depth alone, but faint compact disks show large differences needing dust evolution

evidence.quote: most of the disks in our sample, which represent the bright end of the Lupus disk population, are consistent with radial drift and grain growth.

claims.hypothesis: Optical depth alone explains the observed gas-dust size difference in Lupus disks
claims.experiment: DALI models without dust evolution compared to observed ratios per source
claims.result: 5 of 10 disks have observed ratio above model; other 5 within noise uncertainty
claims.finding: Half need dust evolution plus optical depth; others consistent with optical depth only

evidence.quote: For these disks, we need both dust evolution and optical depth effects to explain the observed $\mathrm{R_{\rm CO,\ obs}}/\mathrm{R_{\rm mm,\ obs}}$.

claims.hypothesis: Faint low-S/N disks also show radial drift
claims.experiment: Used 12CO S/N=3 contour vs 4 x R_mm
claims.finding: Radial drift likely common in faint disks too

evidence.quote: we also find six faint disks with $^{12}$CO emission beyond four times their dust disk size

why_this_method.value: Need quantitative estimate of optical depth contribution to separate it from dust evolution

evidence.quote: quantitative estimates of the effect of line optical depth are required.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Gas-depleted models (low gas-to-dust ratio) tested but gave near identical results to CO underabundance

evidence.quote: We run a gas depleted disk model, where $\Delta_{\rm gd}$ is lowered until the model reproduces the observed $^{13}$CO 3 - 2 line flux.

limitations_admitted.value: Observations lack sensitivity; peak S/N 6-12 is below the S/N >= 10 needed for 20% R_CO accuracy; deeper surveys required

evidence.quote: the peak S/N in our sample varies from $\sim6$ (Sz 100) to $\sim12$ (Sz 133).

limitations_admitted.value: Models overpredict 1.3 mm sizes for several disks

evidence.quote: our models overproduce the extent of the 1.3 millimeter continuum emission despite reproducing the extent of the continuum emission at $890\,\mu$m.
